turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? You gave my son a zero.
I've made one point. Did anyone speak to Owen before you entered that zero?
With respect, this is exactly what lawyers do. Make noise until the facts go away.
You said the facts. So put them on the table. Which ones, and did Owen see them before his gradebook did?
Your son cheated, and you're teaching him that Mom can make it disappear.
My son doesn't lie, Hale. You've called him a cheater with nothing in your hand, so show me a document or I'm walking to the principal's office.
